name: Question 7
problem:
A series RCL circuit has a source electromotive force (EMF) of $10\operatorname{cos}⁡(2t)\,\text{V},$ a resistance of $15\,Ω,$ a capacitance of $0.1\,\text{F},$ and an inductance of $L=5\,\text{H}.$ Find the differential equation governing the amount of charge $q$ (in coulombs) on the capacitor at time $t$ (in seconds).

*Hint: The voltage drop ${V}_{C}$ across the capacitor is related to its charge by $q=C{V}_{C},$ where $C$ is the capacitance measured in Farads.*

A series RCL circuit has a source electromotive force (EMF) of 10cos⁡(2t)V, a resistance of 15Ω, a capacitance of 0.1F, and an inductance of L=5H. Find the differential equation governing the amount of charge q (in coulombs) on the capacitor at time t (in seconds).

Hint: The voltage drop VC across the capacitor is related to its charge by q=CVC, where C is the capacitance measured in Farads.

a
d2qdt2+3dqdt+2q=2cos⁡(2t)
b
d2qdt2+13dqdt+2q=2cos⁡(2t)
c
d2qdt2+3dqdt+12q=2cos⁡(2t)
d
d2qdt2+3dqdt+2q=10cos⁡(2t)
e
d2qdt2+3dqdt+2q=2
